relationships.subject: transverse tibial bone transport
relationships.evidence_quote: The expression of VEGF, bFGF, and PDGF on the 11th day after surgery, on the 18th day after surgery, on the 28th day after surgery, and on the 35th day after surgery was significantly higher than that before surgery (p < 0.05).

relationships.subject: transverse tibial bone transport
relationships.evidence_quote: The VAS pain scores on the 7th day after surgery, on the 28th day after surgery, and on the 180th day after surgery were all significantly lower than that before surgery (p < 0.05)

key_findings: Transverse tibial bone transport gave 94.74% wound healing and limb salvage at 1 year in Wagner stage 4 diabetic foot.
Serum VEGF, bFGF, PDGF and EGF rose after surgery and VAS pain fell.
